correctness.rationale: For every connected graph, two-step recurrence forces uniform firing totals; primitive two-cycles have complementary firing sets. Exact per-vertex legal chip intervals then give the windmill petal weights a_m(k) and center factor mn-K. Product differentiation counts each orbit once in its unique hub-firing phase. The energy-complement involution yields the exact mean. Product-measure tilting has total variation O(n^-1/2) and yields the independent normal firing fluctuation and uniform macroscopic chip-energy limit for fixed m. A standalone direct adjacency simulator checks 846922 normalized labelled candidate states and exact energy symmetry; its recorded result is successful. Finite checks are not used to assert an infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The inspected Jiang 2010 result supplies equal firing counts and the inspected Scully–Zhang–Jiang 2011 theorem supplies a necessary-and-sufficient generic two-cycle inequality. They are acknowledged as starting points. Neither source gives a labelled windmill primitive-orbit generating polynomial, its exponential block factor, the exact finite mean, or the independent Gaussian firing-count and uniform energy joint limit. The 2026 graph-universal middle-stair theorem concerns eventual periods in a chip-density band, not uniform sampling of primitive orbit configurations. Relevant published-finding corpus queries and public searches found no statement that covers those quantitative windmill claims; this is an evidence-limited assessment, not proof of global uniqueness.
residual_risks: An equivalent windmill two-cycle generating polynomial may exist in unindexed historical literature or a database not found by the recorded searches.
Generic two-cycle criteria are strong prior tools; originality attaches only to their nontrivial windmill enumeration and joint limit, not to the criteria themselves.
The complete-graph classic paper was not inspected in full and may cover the n=1 boundary, though its graph family differs for n>=2.
The 2026 middle-stair theorem was inspected for its main claim; a broad non-enumerative theorem cannot itself establish absence of other relevant work.

value.rationale: The exact two-parameter labelled windmill orbit polynomial gives a natural recurrent-state invariant of a common block graph, and the friendship-graph closed form 6n5^(n-1) is an interpretable case. More substantively, a growing-degree articulation vertex creates a macroscopic uniform conserved-energy law while firing counts follow a Gaussian law, with an independent joint limit. This distinguishes a nonregular clustered-network sandpile ensemble from more homogeneous graph cases without relying on routine numerical counts or a claimed new period-two criterion.
